meta.title: Kickgent - AI Assistant & SaaS Webflow Template — Home V1
meta.reference_scope: Home V1 only; this is not the Kickgent template showcase landing page.
meta.theme: Near-black violet, layered transparent UI, purple light columns and rounded product widgets

effects.effect: Tall translucent purple columns rise from a luminous lower horizon.
Large fine circular arcs frame the hero widgets.
Dashboard, progress and files panels use muted transparency, borders and blur.

section.name: Navigation
section.description: Logo left; centered Home, About, Blog, Pages and Pricing links; cart and bordered Get Template button right. Mobile navigation collapses into a closable menu.

section.name: Hero
section.description: Badge above a large centred headline, two CTAs, a central assistant panel, a progress panel, file panel and floating circular feature icons over purple rising light columns.

section.name: Logo rail
section.description: Headline followed by a continuously repeating monochrome partner-logo rail.

section.name: Trust and metrics
section.description: Reviewer avatars and rating pair with short brand statement, category tags and four animated metric blocks.

section.name: Coverage
section.description: Five icon-led cards describe the areas the assistant can help with.

section.name: Features
section.description: Feature-led panels with product illustrations, using active-state interaction rather than a generic card grid.

section.name: Role tools
section.description: Role-oriented content navigation and a rich product panel.

section.name: Plans and integrations
section.description: Plan and integration presentation areas maintain the same violet product-system styling.

section.name: CTA and footer
section.description: High-impact purple CTA, newsletter/footer links and dark ground.

responsive_notes.desktop: Wide hero keeps light columns and overlapping product widgets at the centre.
responsive_notes.mobile: Navigation becomes an explicit keyboard-operable drawer; widgets scale and stack without horizontal overflow.
responsive_notes.motion: Animation is decorative only and must respect prefers-reduced-motion.

adaptation_notes.note: Reference hierarchy and visual language are retained while text is replaced with approved MT4 & MT5 Grey Label homepage content.
Reference template copy, vendor names and template-purchase CTAs are not carried into the brokerage page.
